howto.name: Upload a video
howto.text: MP4 / MOV / MKV / WebM up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose number of frames
howto.text: 3-30. PrivaTools picks evenly-spaced keyframes across the video.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: Each frame becomes one PDF page. Useful for storyboards, content review, or accessibility.

faq.a: Storyboarding, content moderation review, video summarisation for accessibility, lecture notes from recorded talks.

faq.q: Can I get just keyframes (scene changes)?
faq.a: Evenly-spaced frames are the default. Smart scene-change detection is on the roadmap.
Native video resolution. The PDF page size matches.
